displayName: Repurpose my latest X posts for LinkedIn
summary: Rewrite your recent X posts as polished LinkedIn content.

useCases.title: Repurpose my latest X posts for LinkedIn
useCases.message: Help me turn my recent X posts into LinkedIn content. Ask me how many posts to pull. Then go to my X profile, read the latest ones, and rewrite each as a LinkedIn post. You might want to check my existing LinkedIn posts to match the tone. Ask me if you should queue them in Typefully when they're ready.
